feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: iteration 8 (417.9, best) raised wheel_radius to 0.040 m and wheel_track to 0.10 m, with s-bend progress 0.655 and oval 19 of 20 finishes. Iteration 4 (404.6) showed that the 0.09 m track and y=0.08 m row gave 20 of 20 oval finishes. Iteration 1 showed that a 0.10 m track at y=0.07 m gave only 0.236 s-bend progress, so the track width matters separately from the radius. Sensing has been settled. Footprint 0.016 m collapsed the oval to 0 of 20 (iteration 6), and 0.008 m held the oval but lowered s-bend progress to 0.32 (iteration 7), so 0.012 m stays. A wider sensor span raised oscillation and cut oval finishes (iteration 2). The slalom has been flat at progress 0.16 to 0.18 across iterations 1, 3, 4, 5 and 8, which points to speed or reaction time rather than sensing or track. Next race: if the oval keeps 18 or more finishes and steering_oscillation stays below about 0.35 with s-bend progress at or above 0.6, keep mass 0.5 kg and try a shorter body_length to cut yaw inertia further. If oval finishes fall below 18 or oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return mass to 0.6 kg, since the lighter robot is then losing stability. If slalom progress stays at 0.17 to 0.18 with max_error near 0.06 under either mass, the limit is controller-side, and geometry should not be changed further for it.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation on the oval stays below about 0.35 and s-bend progress is at or above 0.6 with mass 0.5 kg, reduce body_length from 0.14 to 0.12 m. Yaw inertia scales with (L^2 + W^2), so this is a further inertia cut with no direct dynamic cost in the simulator. Iteration 8 (mass 0.6 kg) and this run's mass test give the baseline.

If oval finishes fall below 18 of 20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 with mass 0.5 kg, return mass to 0.6 kg and keep the iteration 8 geometry, since iteration 8 gave 19 of 20 finishes with oscillation 0.31 at the heavier mass.

If the slalom progress stays at 0.17 to 0.18 with max_error near 0.06 (iterations 1, 3, 4, 5, 8), do not change sensing or track again. Keep the geometry at the best-supported values and pass the slalom limit to the Integrator as a controller-side reaction-time issue.
